# UI panels

Generated by `cocos-playable-template/scripts/gen_ui_panels.py`. Do **not** hand-edit; re-run the script if you need different colours or sizes.

Each panel ships as a transparent PNG with the artwork inset by the 9-slice border (8 px on the small pills, 16 px on the card). Runtime sets `Sprite.type = SLICED` so the panel stretches without distorting the corners.
